title: Floral carpet (dark blue ground), early 19th century, Azerbaijan
notes: Floral carpet (dark blue ground), early 19th century, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum, Istanbul. inv. no 107 (3956) from Cerablus, Turkey. 200 x 435 cm. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 82. The pattern consists of yellow or blue cartouches with four pairs of small leaves alternating with white stars.
